verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway is a model-routing proxy. It provides a unified API, provider failover, BYOK, budgets and observability for LLM requests, and it does not execute work on its own. Scheduling recurring jobs or workflows belongs to a different product role, such as a compute platform or workflow engine, and nothing in the pack shows the gateway ships a scheduler, cron or workflow capability that would make this axis apply.
